narrative.overview:
This web surface extends the existing Hoard family: charcoal working surfaces, a mint Kinect accent, serif identity and readable sans controls. It gives camera and reconstruction imagery most of the available space. The native Windows studio remains a separate, preserved interface, opened explicitly from the web header.

The source of truth is `ui/scanner.html` plus the shared HoardLink `hoard_link/ui/hoard-theme.css`, served by `hoard_server.py`. This document records that web implementation; it does not prescribe a native studio redesign.
keyCharacteristics: Shared family identity with a restrained Kinect accent.
Flat working surfaces and clear control states.

rules.name: The Family Palette Rule
rules.body: Consume the shared Hoard theme and keep the Kinect mint override local to this app. Preserve the official Faustus launcher's own mark and color instead of recoloring it as a scanner control.

rules.name: The Identity and Work Rule
rules.body: Reserve the serif treatment for identity; keep task titles, instructions and controls in the shared sans stack.

dos: Do extend the shared Hoard family theme and preserve the native studio entry.
Do keep control labels accurate for the selected sensor and subject.
Do expose camera state, disabled actions and experimental tracking limits.
donts: Don't add slogans or substitute a new visual identity for the family theme.
Don't present export completion or UI review as acceptance of scan quality.
